user_query: I'm planning a family movie night and I need some movie recommendations. Can you help me search for popular movie trailers on YouTube and provide their details? Additionally, I would like to find trending TikTok videos related to movie reviews to get some opinions about the recommended movies.

TaskList.description: Search for popular movie trailers on YouTube and retrieve their details.
Collect details of the retrieved movie trailers, including title, duration, and description.
Search for trending TikTok videos related to movie reviews.
Gather opinions and details from the trending TikTok videos, focusing on movie reviews.
